fold_local_validation: For every donor-held-out split, transform minima/sums/means/SDs and PCA are fitted on training donors only; held-out values below the training minimum are clipped to the training lower bound.
main_analysis_status: Matches the frozen E1-E4 preprocessing; no Yeo-Johnson correction is required.
sensitivity_boundary: Any Yeo-Johnson run must be labelled as a separate sensitivity analysis.
